name: astera-linear-source
description: Lists your team's Linear issues in Astera, so a person can make a Job from one.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: A Linear personal API key (Linear: Settings, Security & access, Personal API keys). It reads the issues your account can see.

teamKey.title: Team key
teamKey.description: The team whose issues to list, by its key (ENG for ENG-123). Empty lists every team's.

states.title: State types
states.description: The kinds of state to list, comma separated: triage, backlog, unstarted, started, completed, canceled. Empty lists every state.

apiUrl.title: API URL
apiUrl.description: Linear's GraphQL endpoint. Change it only for a proxy or a test server.
